title: How to Find Customers for Your Home Service Business
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
description:
Get my 147 favorite business ideas for 2025, with full launch plans included here: https://tkopod.co/youtubeD

This is part 2 of a two-part conversation with Daniel. Be sure to listen to part 1 ( https://youtu.be/rQt4rSwYBOg ) to hear how he got started, found the right niche, and set up the systems to grow and succeed.

I sat down with Daniel Cronauer ( https://www.linkedin.com/in/danny-cronauer-a01aa376/ ), to continue our conversation about his entrepreneurial journey. In this episode, Daniel shares his unique strategies for acquiring customers, using rock flyers and yard signs. Daniel also talks about how he expanded his business with Christmas lights, and discusses his experience building his own gym from the ground up. He also touches on his experience with permanent light installations and their drawbacks as a business.

Timestamps below. Enjoy!
